title: Connect cloth operators to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind the existing F8-10/F8-13 cloth operators to the production schedule and staged state, including constraints, pinned vertices and collision consumers. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Installed public cloth-only and cloth/rigid-resource fixtures execute the real production path with eight constraint iterations, one time advance and one spatial publication.
Independent stretch, bend, volume, pin-drift and tunneling oracles pass within the existing input envelope on an applicable physical GPU.
Topology replacement, cold start, capacity failure and reset invalidate caches and preserve atomic public state on failed ticks.
Remove the corresponding blanket runtime restriction only when the supported execution is complete; no second cloth schedule or private adapter physics.
